title: Looks impressive; mostly boring puzzles
text: I was so excited to order this. We ordered the whole 6 month mystery last year but have only opened the first box. The graphics are great. The idea is solid. My experience with customer service was very good. But when we started the first box, we realized that the storylines are just too shallow. They aren’t real meaty mysteries. We got the older version with Jasper and it seems to be mostly word and number puzzles. We found it boring. We had hoped it would be a deep storyline with some real psychological thriller, complex characters and plots. The company is solid and the idea is fantastic. it seems like more of a puzzle box and less of a psychological thriller. Some people might enjoy it, but we were not impressed.
label: negative
